train_graph2text_model: train a graph2text transformer model on wikitext-103 using JAX with configurable batch size and learning rate
eval_transformer_model: evaluate a trained transformer model on the validation or test subset and log perplexity metrics
sample_text_from_model: sample text from a trained graph2text or text-only transformer model using temperature-based sampling
retrieve_text_graph_relevance: compute text-to-graph retrieval relevance scores using a trained transformer model on the eval dataset
configure_training_hyperparameters: configure model hyperparameters including embedding dimension, attention heads, layers, dropout, and learning rate schedule
